title: Sticky Syrup Roly-Poly
description: Golden puff pastry rolled with an entire tin of golden syrup, baked in milk. A gloriously sticky, comforting British pudding.

ingredients.text: 2 x 215g ready-rolled frozen puff pastry (430g total)

steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Grease a large rectangular crumble dish (38cm x 25cm).
Defrost the pastry rolls and unfurl each into a flat rectangle.
Spread the syrup evenly over each piece of pastry, leaving about 2.5cm border. Hold back a couple of teaspoons.
Starting in the bottom left corner, fold each pastry into the centre a few times to make two long diagonal rolls.
Lift rolls into the baking tray, side by side at a slant. Pour the milk over the top and drizzle remaining syrup.
Bake for 30 minutes until pastry is puffed and golden.
Serve straight from the dish with dollops of crème fraîche.
notes: Serves 6–8. Contains an entire tin of golden syrup.
